# Repository memory and agent workflow

- Follow the rules and lifecycle in `AGENTS.md` at the project root.
- Use `.github/memory/` as the source of truth for feature work:
  - `architecture.md`
  - `scenarios.md`
  - `specifications.md`
  - `active-context.md`
  - `issues/`
  - `tasks/lessons-learned.md`
- Inspect those files before making assumptions about architecture, supported flows, or in-progress work.
- Keep memory docs synchronized when behavior or feature scope changes.
